method: Read native netlist; arithmetic with explicit assumptions. No hardware test.
ldo_reference: TI SNVS015F, pp. 4-5: VIN >= 4.75 V, output characteristics for IOUT >= 5 mA.

VIN_example.note: Illustrative plausible diode drop, not guaranteed VF of an assembled part.

stop_all_low_no_external_load.assumptions: V33=3.3 V, LED10 VF=1.9 V, TLC555 Iq=0.2 mA, DISCH near 0 V. Typical estimate only.
stop_all_low_no_external_load.note: LM2937 ground/quiescent current does NOT count as its output load. Removing U1 for bring-up lowers load further.

heartbeat.note: Excludes timer thresholds, X7R temperature/bias effects and output-load waveform.

channels_loaded.note: Resistive DC model, ignores contact resistance and input leakage; heartbeat additionally depends on TLC555 VOH.
